set.body:
Frozen fine-taper-boundary transfer OASIS-TRT-20-11 to 12 fails all four Flashalign candidates with TrialAttemptLimit at the 3 mm affine level. Development OASIS 1 to 10 passes independent geometry and anatomical improvement. Evidence: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-20261002/transfer-1p5mm/run-01 and diagnostic-01/02.txt; protocol docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md.

Terminal probes agree with analytic derivatives at 1e-5 mm, but positive perturbations at 1e-4 or 1e-3 mm cause objective jumps. Fresh independent workspaces show invalidContrastPatches changing 16 to 17, invalidContrastWeight 4.9612971673392936e-5 to 8.416092058371765e-5, with zero rejected interpolations and zero invalidSupportPatches. PatchObjective's minimumContrastEnergy=1e-12 gate replaces active correlation loss with constant outlierCost and no gradient. This is strong evidence of a contrast-status discontinuity; individual switching patch energy has not yet been independently localized.

Next: identify switching patch, verify directly centered energy against independent high-precision arithmetic; if classification is accurate, specify a continuous contrast-reliability objective with consistent derivatives, regression/oracle evidence, then restart development qualification and a newly frozen transfer check. Do not lower thresholds, increase retry budgets or accept failed checkpoints merely to pass. Original transfer remains failed. Parent real-image goal remains open.
set.title: Flashalign real MRI transfer stalls at hard contrast-energy transitions
